targets.behavior_tested: GoApi endpoint with a per-instance key serialises the key into JSON and round-trips it correctly; key=null if absent
targets.mutation: Removed the line `key?.let { put(KeyKey, it) }` in EndpointConverter.toJson() so the key is never written to the JSON object
targets.mutation_rationale: If the key is not persisted, the on-device auth HTTP header sees key=null on next app launch and 401s every search call — user-visible breakage without a crash

targets.behavior_tested: Wire font sizes are clamped to the readable range 14..20; sizes outside that range are never rendered at their wire value
targets.mutation: Changed `postElementDto.size.coerceIn(14, 20)` to `postElementDto.size.coerceIn(1, 200)` in PostConverters.kt — the effective range is so wide that no clamping occurs in practice
targets.mutation_rationale: Without the clamp, a malicious or oversized post can render at wire size 40 (too large) or 4 (too small) — user-visible layout breakage on the topic screen

targets.behavior_tested: A schemeless user-typed URL (e.g. 'djdnjd') yields ProbeResult.Unreachable — never an uncaught IllegalArgumentException (§6.O regression for Crashlytics 39469d3b FATAL crash on 1.2.21)
targets.mutation: Removed the `catch (e: IllegalArgumentException)` block entirely from ProbeMirrorUseCase.invoke(), leaving only `catch (e: IOException)`
targets.mutation_rationale: Without the IAE catch, a schemeless URL causes okhttp3 to throw IllegalArgumentException at Request.Builder.url() which escapes invoke() — reproducing the exact production FATAL crash that put this test in the suite
